\n- owns: `<sub>/slots/<name>`, `<sub>/epoch/<id>`, `<sub>/holds/<place>`, `<sub>/contenders/<name>/<box>`;
\n- writes: `<events root>/.workers/<sub>/<instance>.lock` (put), `<objects root>/<dir>/~lock` (create);
\n- reads: `<sub>/controller/pass`, `<sub>/workers/<name>`, `platform/epoch_floor`, `platform/decommission/<host>`, `<sub>/decommissioned/<host>`, `platform/schema`, `<sub>/<manifest:tables>/<name>`.

\nThe terms of the loop and of the heartbeat (`HEARTBEAT_EVERY`, `POLL`, `WAKE_GAP`, `PASS_SHARE`) and the watchdog (`watchdog`) — [chapter 3.3](03.3-worker.norms.md) N1.2; the stand-in (`stand_in`) and the memory budget (`memory`) — [chapter 3.4](03.4-worker.norms.md) N1.2.
\nSLOT_TERM belongs to the slot contract; HOLD_SKEW and CONTENDER_FRESH belong to observation.
\nEqual current values from different owners are not the same setting.
\nLEASE_TTL, LEASE_MARGIN, CONTEND_EVERY are the owned runtime-constants.tsv rows.
\n**`loop.LEASE_EVERY`** — from the START of the previous step
\n**`<sub>/holds/<place>.holder, until, released, gen`** — as in the slot
\n**`<sub>/holds/<place>.by`** — `<slot name of the holder>` — whose place it is
\nA place that does not meet the complete own-place condition of P/03.2-R087 is foreign or of any box.
\n**`slot`** — closed: two keys
\n**`slot.prefix`** — the slot name is `<prefix>-<suffix>`
\n**`slot.name_env`** — the environment variable from which the worker takes the preferred name when it was not given as an argument (N3 «start()», step 3);
\n**`slot.name_env`** — no key — the name is not taken from the environment
\n**`<sub>/slots/<name>`** — `<server>-<n>` — a name from the unit (P/02.4 N1.1: the instance %i = `<prefix>-<server>-<n>` as an argument, P/02.4 N1.2), `<server>` = SERVER_NAME (P/02.4 N1.2);
\n**`<sub>/slots/<name>`** — n is a decimal integer without leading zeros: 1 — the base process of the role on the server, 2…99 — ordered by the controller (P/04 N3 «order()»);
\n**`<sub>/slots/<name>`** — a choice by number (the reduction of P/04, the workers script of P/02.4 N1.5) compares n as an integer, not by the slot order below
\n**`<sub>/slots/<name>.until`** is for display and clock divergence, not for freshness.
\n**`<sub>/slots/<name>.gen`** — +1 at capture

\nThe name is checked by the grammar above and by the prefix of its own manifest. «By name», the slot order (a numeric suffix — by number without overflow, then the others by name) and the next number `<prefix>-<max + 1>` — in the contract.
\nA first look, a new version or changed bytes give age 0; a repeated read of the same state and a non-answer of the store do not reset it.
\nThe memory of observation is each judge's own; after a restart the first look is fresh again.
\nTherefore held/lapsed are states relative to the observer, not a comparison of until with its clock.
\nJudges with different histories can diverge for a while.
\nThe holder's own slot term ends SLOT_TERM after the request-send moment defined in P/03.2-R010; neither receiving the answer nor rereading the slot extends that term.
\nAn answer to the slot capture or renewal request received after that own slot term has ended does not allow writing without a new confirmed renewal.
\nThe holder's own slot term is local to its own request; it is separate from the observer's version-age memory of P/03.2-R009.
\nA new renewal is a new write, not a replay of the former confirmation.

\nMissing, zero, negative, above-bound or otherwise invalid gen selects the existing refusal-catalogue entry `slot_gen_unreadable`: do not rewrite the candidate, even after `TORN_STILL` or controller permission.
\nPreserve its original bytes, without zeroing or rounding.
\nThe maximum `9007199254740991` is readable.
\nNameOnAnotherBox and capture admission still apply.
\nMachine int gen is an exact operand or an unused zero placeholder; a wide damaged gen never becomes zero.
\nCapture, IO and cryptography still follow the ordinary procedures below.
\nThe priority of refused is above the other two.
\nsince and at use the existing Time type, not arbitrary values.
\nA state change supplies a new since.
\n**`<sub>/epoch/<id>.epoch`** — grows by 1 on every taking of the unit by a worker (a new holder or a return after a loss);
\n**`<sub>/epoch/<id>.epoch`** — a restart of the same unit by the same holder on a revision change does not change the epoch;
\nThe row `<sub>/epoch/<id>` is not deleted.
\n**`<sub>/epoch/<id>.epoch`** is at most 2^53 − 1: an issue beyond that bound is refused before the write (N3 «take_epoch(id)»).
\nWith lost writes and live reads, the old holder stops acting before the move: its own slot term is SLOT_TERM from the confirmed renewal send.
\n**`lease.may_act`** — movement follows the controller contract P/04
\n**`lease.unconfirmed_max`** — default off
\nNetwork retries inside it, including a replay of a write with the same id/the answer again, do not move this moment.
\nA new confirmation request has its own t0; last from requests already confirmed does not decrease.
\nThe doors of the slot, the epoch and the lease are the store of P/01.1: the worker writes and reads them itself.
\nThe procedures of N3 are normative.

\nThe forms of the answers of a read and a write — [P/01.1](../../01-store/spec/01-store.api.openapi.yaml); the contender mark N1.4a is an object: the objects door of [P/05](../../05-resource/spec/05-resource.norms.md) N2.
\nThe grammar of UnitId, WorkerName and the 200-byte limit of a component of Idempotency-Key are kept.
\nThe schema of a component does not promise the capacity of the full key.
\nKeys are not shortened and not hashed on a refusal.
\nThe applicable key rules can be checked before calling the store; a refusal for exceeding the `KEY_BYTES` limit of P/01.1-R156 is handled the same way.
\nThese are local states of an attempt, not fields of the slot row.
\nIts header declares the input and action vocabulary; rows are checked in order, with refusals before permissions.
\nThe adapter derives the inputs from the re-read version and the contracts named there.
\nCandidate order and the cleanup procedure remain the pseudo-code below.
\nThe table does not allow passing to another name for a named process.
\nAn unconfirmed request does not change the start of this window.
\nThat write also requires writing_allowed (N3 «start()», step 5); otherwise do not write.
\nThere is no blind retry with the old guard.

\nWhat protects is the check after the write: the floor is re-read on conflict, and before start_unit a successful «confirm» sees the floor after the write — an epoch below the floor is `lost`, the unit is not launched.
\nThe number is not rolled back and not deleted; a late answer gives neither silent nor a right by unconfirmed_max, not even with forever.
\nThe term of the move is set by the fate of the slot, not by this read alone (P/03.2-R274).
\nDerived defaults, dynamic `slot.name_env` and validation imported from common contracts remain the rules named by each row.
\nThe same with an answer at 24 and a pause before the launch until 26 without a new confirmation.
\nFencing before this transition forbids start_unit; after it, fencing also sees a launch already accepted but not yet completed and cancels/stops it.
\nA late completion of a cancelled start_unit does not publish the led unit anew.
\nThe return of the name and a new read of the assignment do not revive an old attempt: a new call of the gates is needed.
\nThe internal synchronization mechanism is a choice of the implementation; the observable order is mandatory.
\nSilence while data are still allowed postpones the change of revision until a confirmation; the wait for the restart by itself does not turn an effective silent lease into lost.
\nIts columns `word`, `cause`, `outcome`, `diagnostic`, `caller` are the normative cells of a refusal, the rows in file order; `-` is an absent cell.
\nMachine columns identify the surface and any fixed code.
\nA `peer` surface refers to the imported door contract; it creates no HTTP API of the worker.
\nA closed list.
\nSlot, epoch and lease: the refusals of the store of P/01.1, the states of N1.4/N1.6 and the outcomes of the slot/epoch procedures from N3 of this chapter.
\nGoverning rules and the public acceptance scope remain in this chapter.
\nIn this document code reading is not declared done.
\nThey need a separate observer/stand or a reading of the implementation by its owner; an author's review of the documents is not such evidence.
